title: लहानको मधेस आन्दोलन Lahanko Madhesh Aandolan
nepali: नेपालमा मधेसीमूलका मानिसहरूले पहिचान, नागरिकता, सुरक्षा निकाय र निजामति सेवा लगायत राज्यकासबै निकायहरूमा जनसंख्याको आधारमा रोजगारीका अवसरको माग, आत्मनिर्णय सहितको संघीय राज्य, स्वतन्त्र तराईराज्य र सरकारमा प्रतिनिधित्व गर्ने जस्ता सवालहरू लिएर मधेसीहरूले सशस्त्र र शान्तिपूर्ण आन्दोलनहरू गरिरहेका छन्। तत्कालिन मधेसी जनअधिकार फोरम नेपालको नेतृत्वमा २०६३ माघ २ गतेदेखि माघ २६ गतेसम्म मधेस आन्दोलनभएको थियो । जुन आन्दोलनको पहिलो सहिद रमेशकुमार महतोलाई माघ ५ गते लहानमा राजमार्गमा गरिएकोचक्काजाम खोल्ने विवादमा माओवादीहरूले गोलिहानी हत्या गरेका थिए । लहानको उक्त घटना पछि मधेस आन्दोलनलेउग्ररूप लिएको थियो । अझ, माओवादीका नेता मातृका यादवले माघ ६ गते राती माओवादीको हुल ल्याई रमेशकुमारमहतोको लाश लुटेर लगेकाले मधेसीको संस्कृतिमा चुनौती दिएको महसुस गरी माघ ७ गतेदेखि गाउँ गाउँवाट मधेसीहरूलहान आएर सरकारी कार्यालयहरू जलाउन थाले । माओवादीको ज्यादती सहेर बसेका स्थानीय सबै आक्रोशित भइआन्दोलनमा सरिक भएपछि मधेस आन्दोलनले विद्रोहको रूप लियो र यो आन्दोलन पूर्वमा झापादेखि पश्चिममापर्सासम्म फैलियो । मधेस आन्दोलनमा लहानमा ५ जना सहिद भएका थिए । जनयुद्धकालमा दुई–दुई पटक माओवादीलेआक्रमण गरेकाले त्रसित भएका स्थानीय नागरिकहरू तेस्रो पटक माओवादीले मधेस आन्दोलनमा हस्तक्षेप गरेकोले ठूलैघटना हुन्छ भनेर भयभित भएका स्थानीय जनातामा लहान आन्दोलनमा भएका क्रियाकलापहरूले मनोवैज्ञानिक असरपरेको थियो । नागरिकले यस्तो आन्दोलन कहिल्यै नभोगेकाले लहानमा भएको मधेस आन्दोलन नौलो र साहसिक थियो ।यसले मधेसीहरूको शक्ति प्रदर्शनी भएको थियो । आन्दोलनमा सशस्त्र भुमिगत समुहहरूको सक्रियता देखिएकोलेहिंसात्मक गतिविधिहरू भएका थिए । तसर्थ लहानको मधेस आन्दोलनले सिंगो मधेस आन्दोलनको नेतृत्व गरिरहेको थियो। लहानको आन्दोलनमा पहाडी समुदाय, पेशागत संघसंस्था, अन्य राजनीतिक पार्टीहरू समेतले एक्यबद्धता जनाएकाले योआन्दोलन समाजका सबै पक्षको सहभागितामा भएको थियो ।
american_english:
The Madhes Movement in Lahan
In Nepal, people of Madhesi origin have been carrying on armed and peaceful movements alike, raising questions such as the demand for employment opportunities on the basis of population in all state organs, including the security agencies and the civil service, a federal state with the right of self-determination, an independent Tarai state, and representation in the government. Under the leadership of the then Madhesi People's Rights Forum Nepal, a Madhes movement took place from Magh 2, 2063 to Magh 26, 2063. Ramesh Kumar Mahot, the first martyr of that movement, was shot dead by the Maoists on Magh 5 in Lahan, amid the dispute over reopening the highway blockade. After that incident in Lahan, the Madhes movement took on a militant character. What is more, the Maoist leader Matrika Yadav brought in a crowd of Maoists on the night of Magh 6 and carried off Ramesh Kumar Mahot's body, so that the Madhesis felt their culture had been challenged; from Magh 7 onward, Madhesis began coming to Lahan from village to village and setting government offices on fire. Once the local people who had endured Maoist abuses all became outraged and joined the movement, the Madhes movement took the form of a rebellion, and it spread from Jhapa in the east to Parsa in the west. Five people were martyred in Lahan during the Madhes movement. Local citizens, who had been terrorized by two Maoist attacks during the People's War, were frightened that a major incident would occur when the Maoists intervened in the Madhes movement a third time, and the activities of the Lahan movement had a psychological effect on the local people. Since citizens had never experienced such a movement, the Madhes movement in Lahan was new and daring. It was a display of Madhesi strength. Since armed underground groups were active in the movement, there were violent activities. Accordingly, the Madhes movement in Lahan was leading the entire Madhes movement. In the Lahan movement, hill communities, professional associations and other political parties also expressed solidarity, so this movement took place with the participation of all sides of society.

australian_english:
The Madhes Movement in Lahan
In Nepal, people of Madhesi background have been running armed and peaceful movements alike, raising issues like the demand for jobs on a population basis right across the state's institutions, the security agencies and the public service included, a federal set-up with self-determination, a separate Tarai state, and a voice in government. Under the leadership of the then Madhesi People's Rights Forum Nepal, a Madhes movement ran from 2 Magh 2063 to 26 Magh 2063. Ramesh Kumar Mahot, the first martyr of that movement, was shot dead by the Maoists on 5 Magh at Lahan, in the row over getting the blocked highway moving again. After that business at Lahan, the Madhes movement turned militant. What's more, the Maoist leader Matrika Yadav brought a mob of Maoists along on the night of 6 Magh and made off with Ramesh Kumar Mahot's body, so the Madhesis reckoned their culture had been given a serve; from 7 Magh onwards Madhesis started arriving at Lahan from one village after another and torching government offices. Once all the locals who'd copped Maoist heavy-handedness got fired up and joined in, the Madhes movement turned into an out-and-out rebellion, and it spread from Jhapa in the east to Parsa in the west. Five people were killed in the Madhes movement at Lahan. The local mob, who'd been terrified by two Maoist attacks during the People's War, were dreading that a big incident was coming when the Maoists weighed in on the Madhes movement a third time, and what went on at Lahan left a real psychological mark on the locals. Seeing as citizens had never been through anything like it, the Madhes movement at Lahan was new and gutsy. It was a show of Madhesi strength. With armed underground groups active in the movement, there was violent carry-on. So the Madhes movement at Lahan was leading the whole Madhes movement. At Lahan, hill communities, professional bodies and other political parties threw their support behind it too, so the movement happened with every side of society on board.
informal_english:
The Madhes Movement in Lahan
In Nepal, Madhesi people have been running armed and peaceful campaigns alike, putting up questions like jobs dished out on population lines across every arm of the state — the security lads and the civil service thrown in — a federal set-up with self-determination, a free-standing Tarai state, and a seat at the government table. Under the then Madhesi People's Rights Forum Nepal, a Madhes movement ran from 2 Magh 2063 to 26 Magh 2063. Ramesh Kumar Mahot, the first martyr of the whole thing, was shot dead by the Maoists on 5 Magh in Lahan, right in the middle of the carry-on over reopening the blocked highway. After that business in Lahan, the Madhes movement took a hard turn. And if that wasn't enough, the Maoist leader Matrika Yadav brought a gang of Maoists in on the night of 6 Magh and made off with Ramesh Kumar Mahot's body, so the Madhesis reckoned their culture had been given a right slagging; from 7 Magh on, Madhesis started coming into Lahan from one village after another and setting government offices alight. Once every local who'd been putting up with Maoist high-handedness got their dander up and joined in, the Madhes movement became an outright rising, and it spread from Jhapa in the east all the way to Parsa in the west. Five people were killed in the Madhes movement in Lahan. The locals, who'd been badly shaken by two Maoist attacks during the People's War, were in a right panic that something big was coming when the Maoists waded into the Madhes movement a third time, and the whole Lahan affair left a serious psychological mark on them. Seeing as the ordinary people had never been through anything like it, the Madhes movement in Lahan was new and brave. It was Madhesi strength put on show. With armed underground outfits active in the thing, there was violence. So the Madhes movement in Lahan was leading the whole Madhes movement. At Lahan, hill communities, professional bodies and other political parties all came out in support as well, so the movement happened with every part of society taking part.
translator_notes: Informal flavour rendered as Irish English. Date २०६३ is a Bikram Sambat year and is preserved as 2063 (Magh 2, 5, 6, 7, 26) in all variants. The source sentence beginning 'जनयुद्धकालमा…' is syntactically loose in the Nepali; it is rendered as a single sentence in the original order (attacks during the People's War, third Maoist intervention, then the psychological effect), with no clause reordering. No OCR damage noted.
